sloka: स क्रोधेन मया चोक्तो ध्वंसते च पुनः पुनः ।श्रेयो ऽभियुक्तं धर्म्यं च शृणु पुत्र वचो मम ।। ७.११.३९ ॥
transliteration: sa krodhena mayā cokto dhvaṁsate ca punaḥ punaḥ ।śreyo 'bhiyuktaṁ dharmyaṁ ca śṛṇu putra vaco mama ।। 7.11.39 ॥

translations.english: Vishrava continued, "Though I spoke to him with anger, warning him that he would repeatedly perish, now listen, O son, to my words which are conducive to your welfare and righteousness."
